title: Rūpasaññāsuttaṃ
text: 307 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Rūpasaññā, bhikkhave, aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī; saddasaññā… gandhasaññā… rasasaññā… phoṭṭhabbasaññā… dhammasaññā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati ‘saddhānusārī…pe… sambodhiparāyano’’’ti. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
